$description: What is machine-enforced versus what is convention. Category keys below are the REAL keys of token-catalog.json's `referenceable` block, so a drift check can resolve them.

enforced.motionFieldClosure: pagespec.schema.json sets additionalProperties:false on the motion object and closes pattern/trigger/reducedMotionFallback to enums
enforced.allowlistParity: extraction/verify_all.py — fails the run on a phantom entry or an orphan contract
enforced.citationRanges: extraction/verify_all.py — every path:line[-line] must resolve inside the real file
enforced.manifestCounts: extraction/verify_all.py — recomputed from disk, never trusted as written

rawValueRestrictions.color: A generated page must reference a semantic role, never a hex or rgb() literal.
rawValueRestrictions.fontSize: Pick a scale id. The measured px/lineHeight/letterSpacing triple travels with it.
rawValueRestrictions.fontWeight: Only the four measured weights exist; 575 is a variable-axis cut, not a rounding of 600.
rawValueRestrictions.fontFamily: font.sans is a substitution for a licensed face — see assets/asset-roles.json fontsNotDownloaded.
rawValueRestrictions.radius: Pick a radius id. Section shells step 48 -> 40 -> 28 by breakpoint automatically.
rawValueRestrictions.elevation: Almost everything is elevation.none. Three real shadows exist.
rawValueRestrictions.motion: Only the measured easings and durations. There is no scroll-reveal token because the original has none.
rawValueRestrictions.breakpoint: Only 991 / 767 / 479. Tailwind defaults are wrong for this site.

overrides.note: This repo's PageSpec carries no per-instance style or token-override field. Styling belongs to the section and component contracts. There is therefore nothing at the PageSpec layer to mutate in an adversarial token-override test; the equivalent coverage is the catalog/policy drift-injection test in extraction/verify_all.py.
